1.consolidated_definition: En los camiones de carga el madero que cruza de un extremo a otro, formando un caballete, para sostener el encerado. Se aplica igual a la estructura de la casa. También, crucero.
1.en_consolidated_definition: In cargo trucks, the beam that spans from one end to the other, forming a rafter, to support the decking. It is also applied to the structure of a house. Additionally, it refers to a crossbeam or a transverse beam.
